_readme: Every Bob IDE task we ran for this project. Bobcoins and context size come from the task summaries in bob_sessions/.

tasks.title: Write a patch for each of the 10 issues
tasks.outcome: All 10 patches were the right fix, but only 2 applied. The other 8 had wrong line numbers in the diff headers.

tasks.title: Repair the 8 broken patches
tasks.outcome: Didn't work. The subagents kept rewriting whole files, so we stopped it after 1.7 Bobcoins and regenerated the headers with git diff instead. The code in the patches didn't change. We then added a rule to the fix skill so Bob checks its own patches.

tasks.title: Audit ledger_app/ (the hard one)
tasks.outcome: Flagged 12 issues. All 12 were real, and it left all 7 traps alone.
